note: Lesson 7.4 builds automations inside the CRM; they're shown as steps.

walk.title: Solve it: routing and follow-ups for Kora
walk.sample: Rental enquiry, Lekki · ₦900m buyer · returning customer · agent away

steps.say: Kora's target: every enquiry owned within the hour and a first reply in fifteen minutes. The CRM's own workflows do that work.
Each agent gets an available-for-new-leads switch, and the teams come from the design: Lekki, Ibadan, lettings and senior agents.
A-zero-one routes each new deal: back to an existing owner first, then lettings, then by budget, then by office, rotating among available agents.
Timers rescue silence. No call logged within sixty minutes? Rotate again and tell the manager. Stuck in offer made for seven days? One alert.
show: A02: 60 min with no activity → re-route
A04: 7 days in Offer made → alert

steps.say: Stage follow-ups and required fields. Viewed creates a feedback call. Budget, offer amount and lost reason are required at the right stages.
Ten test deals cover every branch. Check owners, tasks and timers, delete the tests, then switch on for new records only and log each automation.

walk.end: That's the automation: every enquiry routed, silence rescued, and every rule tested before it touched a real client.
